entities.summary: Bolshevik, a notable figure in the history of Ukraine, associated with Ukrainian Revolution & Independence Struggle (1918–1921). Preceded by War of Independence & Defeat and Treaty of Warsaw. Their legacy influenced Holodomor — Stalin's genocidal famine in Ukraine.
